product.name: Lead Management
product.description: A system to create, import, and automate leads, generate quotations, and track lead execution.

product.name: Project Management
product.description: A platform to manage site surveys, design workflows, BOQs, activity schedules, work progress, and project handover.

product.name: Vendor Management
product.description: A tool to discover, manage, and rate vendors, manage catalogues, rate contracts, and handle orders and payments.
